description: Zustand keeps small shared state stores for JavaScript and React. A store can hold values and actions that change them. Learn a counter, a reading list and careful browser saving without creating an account. Use a React project with Zustand 5 installed. Hook examples belong in React components; vanilla examples use zustand/vanilla. These package imports require your own build tool.
versionNote: Uses Zustand 5 create, vanilla stores and persist middleware.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to select another simple value you add to the store
Learn to update name without changing count
Learn to set the count to a different number
learningObjectives: Learn to select another simple value you add to the store
Learn to update name without changing count
Learn to set the count to a different number
